1170-6747-8210.easyPrerequisites:
Konstrari Improviser is prepared.
You control at least two artifacts.
1170-6747-8210.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.
1170-6747-8210.notes: You could start with less artifacts as the Heartwoods will count towards the cost reduction. You need to provide additional mana to compensate.

1115-1456-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4231-4321-5270-5682-8095.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Astrid
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

141-3899-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-3899-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

789-2738-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-6558-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-6558-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-6558-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

602-679.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
602-679.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Feast of Sanity trigger.
Repeat from step 2.

6822-7600.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
6822-7600.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Generous Patron's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

2645-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-2438-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

489-2060-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

104-5086-5183-5231-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-5086-5183-5231-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-851-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-3661-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2034-2173-3661-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2781-4890.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dack's Duplicate.
2781-4890.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Dack's Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Dack's Duplicate. Choose to have Dack's Duplicate enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

2797-3918-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn using Retrofitter Foundry's ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2797-3918-4851.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Retrofitter Foundry's other abilities via Trazyn.

1479-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 2, 3 or 4.
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2, 3 or 4.
The combined mana value of the nontoken creature and creature card in your graveyard is no more than 6.
You have an amount of {E} available equal to  or greater than the mana value of the creature card in your graveyard.
1479-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or 3, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, putting another creature with mana value 2 or 3 from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Kodama triggers, putting Chthonian Nightmare from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

511-817-1636-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
511-817-1636-4289.description:
Activate four creatures by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4365-5361-5520.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
4365-5361-5520.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability triggers, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Mondrak attacking each other opponent.
When the Auton Soldier tokens enter the battlefield, Rose Room Treasurer triggers that many times.
Resolve the first two triggers, creating 2^(the number of Mondraks you control plus one) Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate any number of Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1} for each Treasure sacrificed this way.
Resolve the next Rose Room Treasurer trigger, choosing to pay {X} to deal X damage to any target.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 as desired for each remaining trigger.

678-3581-4397.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Frostling, adding {R}.
Frostling dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Frostling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Frostling by paying {R}.
Repeat.

628-997-2060.description:
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 until Crystalline Crawler has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Crystalline Crawler.
Crystalline Crawler dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

851-2034-2367-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

1283-3525-4028.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Zhur-Taa Druid.
Zhur-Taa Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1283-3525-4028.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura for {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

1973-2914-4992.description:
Stormtide makes everything an island, choke prevents them from untapping.
Seedborn muse can untap your lands.
